biotools.summary: CellsFromSpace (CFS) is an R package for deconvolving and annotating spatially distributed omics data without a reference dataset. It utilizes independent component analysis (ICA) to analyze data from various spatial transcriptomics technologies, offering a user-friendly interface for interpretation.
